(async()=>{ await vr180.setSettings({ folders: [{ path: 'C:\\Users\\Owner\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\biglib', private: false }], meta: {}, smartCollections: [] }); setTimeout(()=>location.reload(), 50); return 'reloading'; })()

(async()=>{ const t0=performance.now(); __app.showTab('library'); for(let i=0;i<60;i++){ if(/2,?001 items/.test(document.querySelector('.lib-main .card .muted')?.textContent||'')||document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile').length>10) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } const count=[...document.querySelectorAll('.card-head .muted, .muted')].map(x=>x.textContent).find(t=>/items?$/.test(t)); return { count, tilesInDom: document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile').length, domNodes: document.querySelectorAll('*').length, ms: Math.round(performance.now()-t0) }; })()

(async()=>{ const g=document.querySelector('.vgrid'); const times=[]; for (let i=0;i<20;i++){ const t=performance.now(); g.scrollTop += 900; await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r))); times.push(performance.now()-t); } return { scrollTop: g.scrollTop, maxFrameMs: Math.round(Math.max(...times)), avgMs: Math.round(times.reduce((a,b)=>a+b)/times.length), tilesInDom: document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile').length }; })()

(async()=>{ const i=document.querySelector('.lib-tools input[type=search]'); const q=async(v)=>{ i.value=v; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.muted')].map(x=>x.textContent).find(t=>/items?$/.test(t)); }; const out={ vid: await q('vid_'), notVid: await q('-vid_'), folder: await q('folder:iceland'), year: await q('year:2025'), typo: await q('icelnd') }; await q(''); return out; })()

(async()=>{ [...document.querySelectorAll('.lib-tools .seg button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Timeline').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const heads=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tl-head')].slice(0,3).map(x=>x.innerText.split('\n').join(' ')); return heads; })()

(async()=>{ const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.coll')].find(x=>/On this day/.test(x.textContent)); if(!b) return 'no memories collection'; const n=b.textContent; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const names=[...document.querySelectorAll('.vgrid .tile .n')].map(x=>x.textContent); [...document.querySelectorAll('.coll')][0].click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('.lib-tools .seg button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Recent').click(); return n + ' -> ' + names.join(', '); })()

(async()=>{ const i=document.querySelector('.lib-tools input[type=search]'); i.value='folder:paris'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Save search').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); m.querySelector('input').value='Paris trips'; m.querySelector('.btn.primary').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); i.value=''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const c=[...document.querySelectorAll('.coll')].find(x=>/Paris trips/.test(x.textContent)); return c ? c.innerText.split('\n').join(' ') : 'not saved'; })()
